original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

original_card.first_experiment: First compare the alphabet, role count and length with the fully replayed #1974 census and #2027 mixed-root tariff. Identify a changed premise and a legal native implementation; then price one smallest completed instance before searching larger words.

Repeating the two-register GL3 census or a covered three-register length without changing a hypothesis; a formal group-algebra word without native conversion is a partial result.

actual_scope: Prove that the seven-call profile (a,b,p,q,r,s,t)=(0,2,1,1,1,1,1) admits no word in the PR2085/2112 model, because every rational rank-one solution of R+S+T=3A+B has an AB or PQ character detecting two calls and four targets.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a larger or nonabelian native alphabet. This package stays in the abelian symmetric 2-by-2 model and answers one named three-frame census profile left open after the all-old-once character exclusion.
bottleneck_link: Side result on the signed-frame escape. This profile still needs eight paid calls, so there is no local call-count saving and no selected-frontier change.
stop_rule: Stop after the character proof for the single named profile (0,2,1,1)/(1,1,1). Do not search the other nineteen census profiles or four-or-more frames.
evidence: Scoped proof that every rational rank-one solution of R+S+T=3A+B has parity image avoiding (1,1), so an AB or PQ form extends and detects two calls against four targets. The scale bracket and Cramer determinant are expanded polynomial identities. Lemma 4 is the exhaustive 32-class mod-8 check. The single-line box and five fixtures in verify.py corroborate the written argument and are not a solution census.

open_questions.why_it_matters: Only (1,1,1,1)/(1,1,1) and (0,2,1,1)/(1,1,1) are character-excluded. A surviving profile would be the next place a seven-call word could exist.
open_questions.first_step: Take the named sibling (2,0,1,1)/(1,1,1), whose residual is diag(1,3), and repeat the scale formula with bilinear form 3*x1*y1 + x2*y2.
open_questions.blocked_by: The constants 3, 6, and 12 in this proof are special to 3A+B and do not transfer unchanged.
